name: AutoArticle Generator
author: thegje

sections.description:
AutoArticle Generator is a powerful WordPress plugin that helps you create high-quality, AI-generated articles with customizable writing and image styles. The plugin integrates with Prose Digital’s AI service to deliver professional content for your website.

Features

  • AI-powered article generation with customizable content
  • Multiple writing styles (Professional, Conversational, Journalistic, etc.)
  • Customizable image styles (Realistic, Artistic, Minimalist, etc.)
  • Topic management with exact match or flexible usage options
  • Scheduled article generation with customizable frequency
  • Automatic image generation and attachment
  • Multi-language support

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.2 or higher
  • Active internet connection for API communication

Privacy Policy

This plugin connects to the Prose Digital AI service to generate content. When generating articles, your selected topics, styles, and preferences are sent to the service. No personally identifiable information is shared beyond what is necessary for the service to function. For more information about how your data is handled, please see the Prose Digital Privacy Policy.

Terms of Service: https://prose.digital/terms
Privacy Policy: https://prose.digital/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install autoarticle-generator and activate
  2. Add topics, set writing and image style
  3. Click ‘generate now’, or set a schedule
sections.faq:
Do I need a Prose Digital account?

No, you only need a Prose Digital account for increased usage limits.

What are the usage limits?

Usage limits are determined by your Prose Digital membership level. The plugin will display your remaining article quota in the admin interface.

Can I schedule articles?

Yes, you can schedule articles to be generated automatically. The plugin supports:
* Custom scheduling frequency
* Time-based scheduling
* Topic rotation
* Automatic image generation and attachment

What writing styles are available?

The plugin offers various writing styles including:
* Professional
* Conversational
* Journalistic
* Storytelling
* Analytical
* Educational
* Opinion
* Technical
* Humorous
* Inspirational
* Random

What image styles are available?

The plugin offers various image styles including:
* Realistic
* Artistic
* Minimalist
* Vintage
* Cinematic
* Sketch
* Watercolor
* Digital Art
* Oil Painting
* Cartoon
* Random

What languages are supported?

The plugin supports multiple languages, with English (en) as the default. Additional languages can be selected in the settings.

How are images handled?

The plugin automatically:
* Generates images based on your selected style
* Downloads and optimizes images
* Attaches them to your articles
* Sets them as featured images
* Supports different image sizes (square, landscape, portrait)

Is my data secure?

Yes, the plugin uses secure API connections to transmit data. Your WordPress credentials are never shared with external services.
